summary: Find the beauty hidden in your chest! Make your breasts more beautiful with appropriately sized nipples. Nipple reduction can improve both aesthetics and functionality simultaneously by creating nipples that harmonize with the size and proportion of the breast.

prologue.title: Prologue
prologue.content: If the nipple size is excessively large or protruded, functional problems may arise. Large and protruded nipples can cause pain due to friction with underwear, or stand out even when wearing underwear and clothes. It can also cause breast shape imbalance, acting as a significant complex for some people. Nipple reduction is a delicate surgery that requires applying a precise surgical method tailored to the nipple's shape and excess skin, so it is recommended to decide after sufficient consultation with an experienced specialist.

how_it_is_done.title: How is Nipple Reduction surgery performed?
how_it_is_done.description: Since the surgical method varies depending on the size and length of the nipple, as well as the texture of the nipple areola, it is important to choose a surgical method tailored to the individual.

methods.type: If the nipple width is wide
If the nipple length is long

methods.description: If the nipple is too long or wide, the nipple duct tissue and nipple are cut to reduce the nipple to the desired size and then sutured.
